answer: Agents anchor identity to Verkle polynomial commitments stored in a shared grove, so each new key must post collateral whose valuation is proven against the pruned archival state. Reaching the epoch summit of participation requires stateless validation of these commitments, and any duplicate identity collapses to a single marble-like leaf witness rather than a distinct stake. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
